grasp.note: force and moment of each grasp: all record intervals with the clamp closed (interval means of the wrist sensor, tool-side inertia removed); internal wrench and shares: every 5th interval

sensor_reading.note: largest norm of the force and of the moment read by each wrist sensor over the whole run (means over one record interval), with the range declared in the robot record; reported, not a declared bound

ground.note: wheel loads use the declared equal-stiffness distribution of the recovered ground wrench; values are means over one record interval, the first 0.5 s is excluded

clearance.note: the smallest value excludes the payload against its own supports and guides (pad, guide, mount); the clamp against the payload is excluded by construction

pickup.note: closure error: plant pad loads + wrist-sensor carried load - payload weight

placement.note: closure error: plant pad loads + wrist-sensor carried load - payload weight

consistency.note: rigid-body mechanics determines the total ground force and its centre, not the load of each wheel; the model distributes it with the declared equal-stiffness rule, so wheel loads are compared in the mean

state_integration.note: largest |q(t+T) - q(t) - T mean(v after each step)| over the coordinates, per record interval T
